name: SCGJWD Logistics Public Company Limited
summary: SCGJWD Logistics Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the integrated in-land and oversea logistics business in Thailand and internationally. It operates in two segments, Logistics and Supply Chain Business, and Other Businesses.
